source_spans.locator: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition 29(6), pp.1141-1159 abstract: people are proposed to represent probabilistic causal mechanisms linking category features.
Same abstract: object classification is based on evaluating whether observed features were likely to have been generated by those mechanisms.
Same abstract: experiments manipulating causal knowledge show effects on individual-feature importance and interfeature correlations in classification.

provenance.venue: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition

temporal_scope: causal knowledge is acquired before object classification
